right_click_cancels.label: Right-click cancels
right_click_cancels.description: Right-clicking the widget immediately cancels the timer and lets the computer sleep again.

middle_click_cancels.label: Middle-click cancels
middle_click_cancels.description: Middle-clicking the widget immediately cancels the timer and lets the computer sleep again.

notify_on_finish.label: Notify when the timer ends
notify_on_finish.description: Show a notification when the countdown finishes and caffeine is disabled again.

show_remaining.label: Show remaining time
show_remaining.description: Display the time left next to the coffee glyph while a timer is running.

notify.done_body: The {duration} caffeine session ended — the computer can sleep again.
notify.unavailable_body: Idle inhibition is not supported here, so the timer was cancelled.
